Namespace ShapeEngine.Text

Classes

BitmapFont

Simple bitmap font drawer using string arrays for each character.

BitmapFontAtlas

Represents a bitmap font atlas that arranges glyphs into a texture for efficient rendering. Provides methods to generate, draw, and manage the atlas and its glyphs.

ED_Block

Emphasis drawer that draws a solid block background for emphasized text.

ED_Transparent

Emphasis drawer that does not render any background or foreground, resulting in transparent emphasis.

ED_Underline

Emphasis drawer that draws an underline beneath the emphasized text.

Emphasis

Represents an emphasis style for text, including background and foreground drawing and color information.

TextEmphasis

Associates an Emphasis style with a regular expression for keyword-based text emphasis.

TextEmphasisBox

Provides a text box with support for word emphasis and caret rendering.

TextFont

Provides font and color settings, as well as text rendering and measurement utilities for drawing text in the ShapeEngine.

TextInputBox

Provides a text input box with caret, text editing, and entry management functionality.
